purpose: Analytic verification fixture for the pore-law code (units, length composition). Not a carbon-nanotube law and not offered in the interface.
label: Hagen–Poiseuille with Navier slip plus Sampson entrance and exit (analytic reference)

provenance.interior: r_interior = 8 mu / (pi a^4 (1 + 4 b / a)) in Pa s/m^4 (Hagen–Poiseuille with Navier slip length b)
provenance.entranceExit: R_entry = R_exit = 3 mu / (2 a^3) in Pa s/m^3 (Sampson's orifice resistance 3 mu / a^3 split equally)
provenance.validity: continuum hydrodynamics; not valid at sub-1-nm diameters
